message: Good news first: the check found no wrong connections and no failed tests. The architecture is complete and joined up end to end. The 8 blockers have two causes, and neither is a design mistake. The 2 existing sources (logs and asset context) need a plan for how we reference or import them. The other 6 IBM components (Event Streams, Code Engine redaction and triage, Object Storage, OpenSearch and watsonx.ai) have no supported generator contract yet. The only IBM contract available today is private object storage. Applying it to the evidence store wouldn't fix the main gap, and narrowing the scope to storage would break what you asked for. So there's no supported graph correction to make right now. Closing these gaps is product engineering work: native IBM implementations for Event Streams, Code Engine, OpenSearch and watsonx.ai, with this design revision 2 (artifact 5dd2d956…) as the test case. So I'm leaving the diagram as it is, with every requirement and safeguard still open, and nothing has been deployed or checked against a real model. To plan how we reference those two existing sources, how do the synthetic alerts and the CMDB export reach us today: pushed to a Kafka topic, dropped as files, or pulled from an API?
